Mainly I learned that Ghostscript is doing a lot to make its PostScript interpreter fast: with the non-graphical test programs I could think up, GhostScript was many times faster interpreting the program (even computationally intensive ones) than my runtime (called "egon") could execute the byte-compiled PostScript.
